Frequently asked questions

What is PLAYGROUND?

PLAYGROUND is a gaming creative marketplace where gamers, streamers, esports teams, designers and game developers discover assets, customise templates in a browser editor, use free gaming tools and share their work.

Is PLAYGROUND free to use?

Yes. Browsing, free downloads, the gaming tools and basic Studio exports are free. Premium assets are bought one-off, and an optional Pro plan is planned for extra editor features.

Can I use free assets in a commercial project?

Only if the asset’s license says so. Every listing shows a license summary before you download. Free License assets allow personal use and monetised streams with attribution; CC0 assets allow any use; Standard and Extended licenses cover commercial work as described on the asset page.

What file formats are included?

Each asset lists exactly the formats it ships with (for example PSD, SVG, PNG, FBX or WAV). PLAYGROUND never lists a format or software compatibility that the download does not actually contain.

Can I make a stream overlay or banner without Photoshop?

Yes. The Customization Studio edits text, shapes and images in your browser and exports PNG or JPG, with a transparent-background option for PNG.
